text.Dá mais prioridade ao VALORANT no uso do: Gives VALORANT higher CPU priority when other programs are running. May affect background tasks.

text.Dá mais prioridade ao OBS e ao Streamlab: Gives OBS and Streamlabs higher CPU priority during streaming and recording. May affect other open programs.
text.Dá mais prioridade aos editores de vídeo: Gives the video editors included in this profile higher CPU priority. May affect other open programs.

text.FPS indica quantos quadros o jogo aprese: FPS is the average number of frames presented by the game per second. Higher values usually feel smoother. This measurement does not directly count frames displayed by the monitor.
text.O 1% low resume os momentos mais lentos:: The 1% low summarizes the slowest moments using the mean of the slowest 1% of frame intervals. Higher values usually indicate fewer drops during those moments.
text.Tempo médio entre os quadros, em milisse: Average interval between frames, in milliseconds. A lower value means the game takes less time to present the next frame.
text.P99: 99% dos intervalos ficaram neste te: P99: 99% of frame intervals were at or below this time. A high value may accompany stutters. It is not the worst frame time in the entire measurement.
text.A linha mostra amostras dos tempos por q: The line shows sampled frame intervals in measurement order. Upward spikes indicate longer intervals. Compare the same scene and graphics settings.
text.Abra o jogo → escolha na lista → clique: Open the game → choose it from the list → click Measure and return to the game.
text.Ritmo dos quadros · saltos para cima ind: Frame pacing · upward spikes indicate longer delays
